The sorted table: write path (`TableBuilder`), read path (`Table`),\n//! two-level sparse index lookup, range scans and whole-file validation.\n//!\n//! ## Synchronization boundaries\n//!\n//! Data blocks are appended as they fill, but bytes on disk are not a\n//! committed table until [`TableBuilder::finish`] returns: it writes the\n//! metaindex, index and footer, then issues exactly one `sync_all`. The\n//! file-based helper [`build_table_sorted`] additionally writes to a temp\n//! name, renames over the final name and syncs the parent directory, so a\n//! table file appears atomically and a failed build leaves no final file.\n\nuse std::fs::{self, File};\nuse std::path::{Path, PathBuf};\n\nuse crate::block::{self, Block, BlockBuilder, Cursor};\nuse crate::coding;\nuse crate::error::{Error, Result};\nuse crate::format::{\n    self, BlockHandle, Footer, BLOCK_TRAILER_LEN, BLOCK_TYPE_DATA, FOOTER_LEN,\n    MAX_BLOCK_SIZE,\n};\nuse crate::io::{\n    append_all, read_fill, PosixReader, PosixWriter, RandomAccessFile, WritableFile,\n};\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Options\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n/// Builder options.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct Options {\n    /// Flush a data block once its estimated encoded size reaches this many\n    /// bytes. (A single larger-than-target entry still gets its own block.)\n    pub block_size: usize,\n    /// Entries between restart points inside a data block.\n    pub restart_interval: u32,\n}\n\nimpl Default for Options {\n    fn default() -> Self {\n        Options {\n            block_size: 4096,\n            restart_interval: 16,\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nimpl Options {\n    pub fn validate(&self) -> Result<()> {\n        if self.block_size < 32 {\n            return Err(Error::invalid_argument(\"block_size must be >= 32\"));\n        }\n        if self.block_size > MAX_BLOCK_SIZE {\n            return Err(Error::invalid_argument(\"block_size exceeds maximum\"));\n        }\n        if self.restart_interval == 0 {\n            return Err(Error::invalid_argument(\"restart_interval must be >= 1\"));\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n\n/// Summary returned by a successful build.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct BuildStats {\n    pub bytes: u64,\n    pub entries: u64,\n    pub data_blocks: u64,\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Write path\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n/// Builds one table over a generic [`WritableFile`].\npub struct TableBuilder<W: WritableFile> {\n    writer: W,\n    options: Options,\n    data: BlockBuilder,\n    index: BlockBuilder,\n    last_key: Vec<u8>,\n    offset: u64,\n    num_entries: u64,\n    num_data_blocks: u64,\n    pending_index_entry: bool,\n    pending_handle: Option<BlockHandle>,\n    finished: bool,\n}\n\nimpl<W: WritableFile> TableBuilder<W> {\n    pub fn new(writer: W, options: Options) -> Result<TableBuilder<W>> {\n        options.validate()?;\n        Ok(TableBuilder {\n            writer,\n            data: BlockBuilder::new(options.restart_interval)?,\n            index: BlockBuilder::new(1)?,\n            last_key: Vec::new(),\n            offset: 0,\n            num_entries: 0,\n            num_data_blocks: 0,\n            pending_index_entry: false,\n            pending_handle: None,\n            finished: false,\n            options,\n        })\n    }\n\n    pub fn entries(&self) -> u64 {\n        self.num_entries\n    }\n\n    /// Append a key/value pair. Keys MUST be strictly increasing.\n    pub fn add(&mut self, key: &[u8], value: &[u8]) -> Result<()> {\n        if self.finished {\n            return Err(Error::invalid_argument(\"builder already finished\"));\n        }\n        if self.num_entries > 0 && key <= self.last_key.as_slice() {\n            return Err(Error::invalid_argument(format!(\n                \"keys must be strictly increasing: new key {} <= last key {}\",\n                coding::to_hex(key),\n                coding::to_hex(&self.last_key)\n            )));\n        }\n\n        if self.pending_index_entry {\n            // Emit an index separator for the block flushed earlier.\n            let mut separator = self.last_key.clone();\n            find_shortest_separator(&mut separator, key);\n            let handle = self\n                .pending_handle\n                .take()\n                .expect(\"pending handle must exist\");\n            self.index.add(&separator, &encode_handle(handle));\n            self.pending_index_entry = false;\n        }\n\n        self.data.add(key, value);\n        self.last_key.clear();\n        self.last_key.extend_from_slice(key);\n        self.num_entries += 1;\n\n        if self.data.estimated_size() >= self.options.block_size {\n            self.flush_data_block()?;\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    fn flush_data_block(&mut self) -> Result<()> {\n        if self.data.is_empty() {\n            self.pending_index_entry = false;\n            return Ok(());\n        }\n        let payload = self.data.finish().to_vec();\n        let handle = append_block(&mut self.writer, self.offset, &payload)?;\n        self.offset = handle.end_exclusive()?;\n        self.data.reset();\n        self.num_data_blocks += 1;\n        self.pending_index_entry = true;\n        self.pending_handle = Some(handle);\n        Ok(())\n    }\n\n    /// Flush trailing data, write metaindex/index/footer and sync. Consumes the\n    /// builder; the writer itself is dropped afterwards.\n    pub fn finish(mut self) -> Result<BuildStats> {\n        self.flush_data_block()?;\n\n        if self.pending_index_entry {\n            let mut successor = self.last_key.clone();\n            find_short_successor(&mut successor);\n            let handle = self\n                .pending_handle\n                .take()\n                .expect(\"pending handle must exist\");\n            self.index.add(&successor, &encode_handle(handle));\n            self.pending_index_entry = false;\n        }\n\n        // Empty metaindex block (no optional sections in this version).\n        let mut meta = BlockBuilder::new(1)?;\n        let meta_payload = meta.finish().to_vec();\n        let meta_handle = append_block(&mut self.writer, self.offset, &meta_payload)?;\n        self.offset = meta_handle.end_exclusive()?;\n\n        let index_payload = self.index.finish().to_vec();\n        let index_handle = append_block(&mut self.writer, self.offset, &index_payload)?;\n        self.offset = index_handle.end_exclusive()?;\n\n        let mut footer_bytes = Vec::with_capacity(FOOTER_LEN);\n        Footer::new(meta_handle, index_handle).encode_to(&mut footer_bytes)?;\n        append_all(&mut self.writer, &footer_bytes)?;\n        self.offset += footer_bytes.len() as u64;\n\n        // The single durability boundary for the whole table.\n        self.writer.sync()?;\n        self.finished = true;\n\n        Ok(BuildStats {\n            bytes: self.offset,\n            entries: self.num_entries,\n            data_blocks: self.num_data_blocks,\n        })\n    }\n}\n\nfn append_block<W: WritableFile + ?Sized>(\n    w: &mut W,\n    offset: u64,\n    payload: &[u8],\n) -> Result<BlockHandle> {\n    if payload.len() > MAX_BLOCK_SIZE {\n        return Err(Error::invalid_argument(\"block payload exceeds maximum\"));\n    }\n    let mut buf = Vec::with_capacity(payload.len() + BLOCK_TRAILER_LEN);\n    let probe = format::write_block(&mut buf, BLOCK_TYPE_DATA, payload);\n    debug_assert_eq!(probe.offset, 0);\n    append_all(w, &buf)?;\n    Ok(BlockHandle::new(offset, payload.len() as u64))\n}\n\nfn encode_handle(h: BlockHandle) -> Vec<u8> {\n    let mut v = Vec::new();\n    h.encode_to(&mut v);\n    v\n}\n\nfn decode_handle_value(value: Ok(handle)\n}\n\n/// Mutate `start` into a short key such that `start <= result < limit`\n/// (LevelDB's `FindShortestSeparator`).\nfn find_shortest_separator(start: &mut Vec<u8>, limit: &[u8]) {\n    let min_len = start.len().min(limit.len());\n    let mut diff = 0;\n    while diff < min_len && start[diff] == limit[diff] {\n        diff += 1;\n    }\n    if diff >= min_len {\n        // One is a prefix of the other: cannot shorten.\n        return;\n    }\n    let diff_byte = start[diff];\n    if diff_byte < 0xff && diff_byte + 1 < limit[diff] {\n        start[diff] += 1;\n        start.truncate(diff + 1);\n    }\n}\n\n/// Shortest key strictly greater than `key` (used as the final index bound).\nfn find_short_successor(key: &mut Vec<u8>) {\n    for b in key.iter_mut() {\n        if *b != 0xff {\n            *b += 1;\n            let pos = b.as_slice().as_ptr() as usize - key.as_ptr() as usize;\n            key.truncate(pos + 1);\n            return;\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// File-based atomic build\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n/// Sort and strictly validate `entries`, then build `dir/name` atomically.\n///\n/// The temp file is removed on any error. `unique_suffix` must make the temp\n/// name unique among concurrent builds in the same directory.\npub fn build_table_sorted(\n    dir: &Path,\n    name: &str,\n    entries: &[(Vec<u8>, Vec<u8>)],\n    options: Options,\n    unique_suffix: u64,\n) -> Result<BuildStats> {\n    validate_table_name(name)?;\n    let mut sorted: Vec<&(Vec<u8>, Vec<u8>)> = entries.iter().collect();\n    sorted.sort_by(|a, b| a.0.cmp(&b.0));\n    for pair in sorted.windows(2) {\n        if pair[0].0 == pair[1].0 {\n            return Err(Error::invalid_argument(format!(\n                \"duplicate key: {}\",\n                coding::to_hex(&pair[0].0)\n            )));\n        }\n    }\n\n    let final_path = dir.join(name);\n    let tmp_name = format!(\".{name}.tmp.{unique_suffix}\");\n    let tmp_path = dir.join(&tmp_name);\n\n    let result = (|| -> Result<BuildStats> {\n        let writer = PosixWriter::create(&tmp_path)?;\n        let mut builder = TableBuilder::new(writer, options)?;\n        for (k, v) in &sorted {\n            builder.add(k, v)?;\n        }\n        let stats = builder.finish()?;\n        fs::rename(&tmp_path, &final_path)?;\n        // Sync the directory entry so the rename itself is durable.\n        sync_directory(dir)?;\n        Ok(stats)\n    })();\n\n    if result.is_err() {\n        let _ = fs::remove_file(&tmp_path);\n    }\n    result\n}\n\npub fn validate_table_name(name: &str) -> Result<()> {\n    if name.is_empty()\n        || name == \".\"\n        || name == \"..\"\n        || name.contains('/')\n        || name.contains('\\\\')\n        || name.contains('\\0')\n    {\n        return Err(Error::invalid_argument(\n            \"table name must be a non-empty path component without /, \\\\ or NUL\",\n        ));\n    }\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn sync_directory(dir: &Path) -> Result<()> {\n    let f = File::open(dir)?;\n    f.sync_all()?;\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Read path\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n/// An open, read-only table.\npub struct Table<R: RandomAccessFile> {\n    file: R,\n    file_size: u64,\n    footer: Footer,\n    index_block: Block,\n}\n\nimpl Table<PosixReader> {\n    /// Open a table directly from a filesystem path.\n    pub fn open_path(path: &Path) -> Result<Table<PosixReader>> {\n        let size = fs::metadata(path)?.len();\n        Table::open(PosixReader::open(path)?, size)\n    }\n}\n\nimpl<R: RandomAccessFile> Table<R> {\n    /// Open a table. Only the footer and the index block are read eagerly\n    /// (fail fast); data blocks are read on demand.\n    pub fn open(file: R, file_size: u64) -> Result<Table<R>> {\n        if file_size < FOOTER_LEN as u64 {\n            return Err(Error::corruption(format!(\n                \"file too small to contain a footer: {file_size} bytes\"\n            )));\n        }\n        let footer = {\n            let mut buf = vec![0u8; FOOTER_LEN];\n            let off = file_size - FOOTER_LEN as u64;\n            let n = read_fill(&file, &mut buf, off)?;\n            if n != FOOTER_LEN {\n                return Err(Error::corruption(\"short footer read\"));\n            }\n            Footer::decode(&buf)?\n        };\n        let index_block = read_block_checked(&file, file_size, footer.index)?;\n        Ok(Table {\n            file,\n            file_size,\n            footer,\n            index_block,\n        })\n    }\n\n    pub fn file_size(&self) -> u64 {\n        self.file_size\n    }\n\n    pub fn data_block_count_from_index(&self) -> Result<usize> {\n        // Index holds exactly one entry per data block.\n        let mut cur = self.index_block.first()?;\n        let mut n = 0;\n        while cur.valid() {\n            n += 1;\n            cur.next()?;\n        }\n        Ok(n)\n    }\n\n    /// Point lookup: `Some(value)` iff `key` exists.\n    pub fn get(&self, key: &[u8]) -> Result<Option<Vec<u8>>> {\n        let handle = match self.index_handle_for(key)? {\n            Some(h) => h,\n            None => return Ok(None),\n        };\n        let block = self.read_block(handle)?;\n        let cur = block.seek(key)?;\n        if cur.valid() && cur.key() == key {\n            Ok(Some(cur.value()?.to_vec()))\n        } else {\n            Ok(None)\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Open a forward range scan.\n    pub fn scan(&self, options: ScanOptions) -> Result<ScanIter<'_, R>> {\n        ScanIter::new(self, options)\n    }\n\n    fn index_handle_for(&self, key: &[u8]) -> Result<Option<BlockHandle>> {\n        let cur = self.index_block.seek(key)?;\n        if !cur.valid() {\n            return Ok(None);\n        }\n        Ok(Some(decode_handle_value(cur.value()?)?))\n    }\n\n    fn read_block(&self, handle: BlockHandle) -> Result<Block> {\n        read_block_checked(&self.file, self.file_size, handle)\n    }\n\n    /// Read every byte of the file and enforce every format invariant.\n    pub fn validate(&self) -> Result<ValidationReport> {\n        let mut report = ValidationReport {\n            file_size: self.file_size,\n            ..ValidationReport::default()\n        };\n\n        // 1. Index block: walk entries and check handles are contiguous and\n        //    bounded.\n        let index_block = read_block_checked(&self.file, self.file_size, footer.index)?;\n        let index_stats = block::validate_entries(&index_block)?;\n        let mut expected_offset = 0u64;\n        let mut prev_last_key: Option<Vec<u8>> = None;\n        let mut cur = index_block.first()?;\n        while cur.valid() {\n            let sep = cur.key().to_vec();\n            let handle = decode_handle_value(cur.value()?)?;\n            if handle.offset != expected_offset {\n                return Err(Error::corruption(format!(\n                    \"data block gap/overlap at offset {} (expected {expected_offset})\",\n                    handle.offset\n                )));\n            }\n            let end = handle\n                .end_exclusive()\n                .and_then(|e| check_inside_file(e, self.file_size))?;\n            if end > footer.metaindex.offset {\n                return Err(Error::corruption(\"data block runs past metaindex\"));\n            }\n            expected_offset = end;\n\n            // 5. The referenced data block itself.\n            let data_block = read_block_checked(&self.file, self.file_size, handle)?;\n            let stats = block::validate_entries(&data_block)?;\n            report.total_entries += stats.entries;\n            report.total_restarts += stats.restarts;\n            report.data_blocks.push(BlockReport {\n                offset: handle.offset,\n                payload_size: handle.size,\n                entries: stats.entries,\n                restarts: stats.restarts,\n            });\n\n            // 6. Cross-block ordering and separator correctness.\n            let first = data_block.first()?;\n            if let Some(last) = &prev_last_key {\n                if last.as_slice() >= first.key() {\n                    return Err(Error::corruption(\n                        \"keys do not increase across the data block boundary\",\n                    ));\n                }\n            }\n            // Separator: >= last key of its block and < first key of the next\n            // block (the final successor is checked separately against EOF).\n            let mut last_cur = first;\n            while last_cur.next()? {}\n            let last_key = last_cur.key().to_vec();\n            if sep.as_slice() < last_key.as_slice() {\n                return Err(Error::corruption(\n expected_offset != footer.metaindex.offset {\n            return Err(Error::corruption(\n                \"data blocks do not tightly precede the metaindex block\",\n            ));\n        }\n Final index successor must be strictly greater than the last key.\n        if let Some(last) = prev_last_key {\n            let mut last_cur = index_block.first()?;\n            while last_cur.next()? {}\n            if last_cur.valid() && last_cur.key().as_slice() <= last.as_slice() {\n                return Err(Error::corruption(\n                    \"final index successor is not greater than the last data key\",\n                ));\n            }\n        }\n\n        report.ok = true;\n        Ok(report)\n    }\n}\n\nfn check_inside_file(end: u64, file_size: u64) -> Result<u64> {\n    if end > file_size {\n        return Err(Error::corruption(\"block handle reaches past end of file\"));\n    }\n    Ok(end)\n}\n\n/// Read payload + trailer, enforce bounds/type/CRC, then parse the block.\nfn read_block_checked<R: RandomAccessFile + ?Sized>(\n    file: &R,\n    file_size: u64,\n    handle: BlockHandle,\n) -> Result<Block> {\n    if handle.size > MAX_BLOCK_SIZE as u64 {\n return Err(Error::corruption(format!(\n            \"block at {}+{} reaches past end of file ({file_size})\",\n            handle.offset, handle.size\n        )));\n    }\n\n    let mut payload = payload.len());\n    crc_input.push(block_type);\n    crc_input.extend_from_slice(&payload);\n    let computed = coding::mask_crc(coding::crc32c(&crc_input));\n    if stored != computed {\n Excluded(Vec<u8>),\n}\n\n/// Scan parameters.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct ScanOptions {\n    pub start: Bound,\n    pub end: Bound,\n    pub limit: Option<u64>,\n}\n\nimpl Default for ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n/// Builds one table over a generic [`WritableFile`].\npub struct TableBuilder<W: WritableFile> {\n    writer: W,\n    options: Options,\n    data: BlockBuilder,\n    index: BlockBuilder,\n    last_key: Vec<u8>,\n    offset: u64,\n    num_entries: u64,\n    num_data_blocks: u64,\n    pending_index_entry: bool,\n    pending_handle: Option<BlockHandle>,\n    finished: bool,\n}\n\nimpl<W: WritableFile> TableBuilder<W> {\n    pub fn new(writer: W, options: Options) -> Result<TableBuilder<W>> {\n        options.validate()?;\n        Ok(TableBuilder {\n            writer,\n            data: BlockBuilder::new(options.restart_interval)?,\n            index: BlockBuilder::new(1)?,\n            last_key: Vec::new(),\n            offset: 0,\n            num_entries: 0,\n            num_data_blocks: 0,\n            pending_index_entry: false,\n            pending_handle: None,\n            finished: Vec<u8>)],\n    options: Options,\n    unique_suffix: u64,\n) -> Result<BuildStats> {\n    validate_table_name(name)?;\n    let mut sorted: Vec<&(Vec<u8>, Vec<u8>)> = entries.iter().collect();\n    sorted.sort_by(|a, b| a.0.cmp(&b.0));\n    for pair in sorted.windows(2) {\n        if pair[0].0 == pair[1].0 {\n            return Err(Error::invalid_argument(format!(\n                \"duplicate let tmp_path = dir.join(&tmp_name);\n\n    let result = (|| -> Result<BuildStats> {\n        let writer = PosixWriter::create(&tmp_path)?;\n        let mut builder = TableBuilder::new(writer, options)?;\n        for (k, v) in &sorted {\n            builder.add(k, v)?;\n        }\n        let stats = builder.finish()?;\n        fs::rename(&tmp_path, &final_path)?;\n        // Sync the directory entry so the rename itself is durable.\n        sync_directory(dir)?;\n        Ok(stats)\n    })();\n\n    if result.is_err() {\n        let _ = fs::remove_file(&tmp_path);\n    }\n filesystem path.\n    pub fn open_path(path: &Path) -> Result<Table<PosixReader>> {\n        let size = fs::metadata(path)?.len();\n        Table::open(PosixReader::open(path)?, size)\n    }\n}\n\nimpl<R: RandomAccessFile> Table<R> {\n    /// Open a table. {"parentUuid":"8c7c739f-3fe7-42ec-9cb3-b294e6888ad6","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_junx3td8zlm78ahi7ntigsy7","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp8/b/src/server.rs","content":"//! Dependency-free local HTTP verification endpoint.\n//!\n//! Binary keys/values cross the wire as lowercase hex strings. JSON is emitted\n//! and parsed by the tiny helpers in this module — the only accepted request\n//! content type is a small JSON object, so a full JSON dependency is overkill.\n\nuse std::collections::HashMap;\nuse std::io::{Read, Write};\nuse std::net::{TcpListener, TcpStream};\nuse std::path::{Path, PathBuf};\nuse std::sync::Arc;\nuse std::thread;\nuse std::time::{SystemTime, UNIX_EPOCH};\n\nuse crate::coding;\nuse crate::error::{Error, Result};\nuse crate::table::{\n    self, Bound, BuildStats, Options, ScanOptions, Table, ValidationReport,\n};\nuse crate::io::PosixReader;\n\n/// Server configuration and the directory tables live in.\npub struct HttpServer {\n    dir: PathBuf,\n    listener: TcpListener,\n}\n\nimpl HttpServer {\n    pub fn bind(dir: PathBuf, addr: &str) -> Result<HttpServer> {\n        std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir)?;\n        let listener = TcpListener::bind(addr)?;\n        Ok(HttpServer { dir, listener })\n    }\n\n    pub fn local_addr(&self) -> Result<String> {\n        Ok(self.listener.local_addr()?.to_string())\n    }\n\n    /// Accept connections until the process is killed.\n    pub fn serve(self) -> Result<()> {\n        let dir = Arc::new(self.dir);\n        for stream in self.listener.incoming() {\n            match stream {\n                Ok(stream) => {\n                    let dir = Arc::clone(&dir);\n                    thread::spawn(move || {\n                        if let Err(e) = handle_connection(stream, &dir) {\n                            eprintln!(\"connection error: {e}\");\n                        }\n                    });\n                }\n                Err(e) => eprintln!(\"accept error: {e}\"),\n            }\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n\nfn handle_connection(mut stream: TcpStream, dir: &Path) -> Result<()> {\n    stream.set_read_timeout(Some(std::time::Duration::from_secs(10)))?;\n    stream.set_nodelay(true)?;\n\n    let mut req = Request::read(&mut stream)?;\n    let response = route(&mut req, dir);\n    write_response(&mut stream, &response)?;\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Request / response types\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nstruct Request {\n    method: String,\n    path: String,\n    query: HashMap<String, String>,\n    body: Vec<u8>,\n}\n\nimpl Request {\n    fn read(stream: &mut TcpStream) -> Result<Request> {\n        let mut buf = Vec::with_capacity(8192);\n        let mut tmp = [0u8; 4096];\n        let header_end = loop {\n            if let Some(pos) = find_double_crlf(&buf) {\n                break pos;\n            }\n            if buf.len() > 64 * 1024 {\n                return Err(Error::invalid_argument(\"headers too large\"));\n            }\n            let n = stream.read(&mut tmp)?;\n            if n == 0 {\n                return Err(Error::invalid_argument(\"connection closed mid-request\"));\n            }\n            buf.extend_from_slice(&tmp[..n]);\n        };\n\n        let head = String::from_utf8_lossy(&buf[..header_end]).to_string();\n        let mut lines = head.split(\"\\r\\n\");\n        let request_line = lines\n            .next()\n            .ok_or_else(|| Error::invalid_argument(\"empty request line\"))?;\n        let mut parts = request_line.split(' ');\n        let method = parts\n            .next()\n            .ok_or_else(|| Error::invalid_argument(\"missing method\"))?\n            .to_string();\n        let target = parts\n            .next()\n            .ok_or_else(|| Error::invalid_argument(\"missing target\"))?;\n        let (path, query) = match target.split_once('?') {\n            Some((p, q)) => (p.to_string(), parse_query(q)),\n            None => (target.to_string(), HashMap::new()),\n        };\n\n        let mut content_length = 0usize;\n        for line in lines {\n            if let Some(rest) = line\n                .strip_prefix(\"Content-Length:\")\n                .or_else(|| line.strip_prefix(\"content-length:\"))\n            {\n                content_length = rest\n                    .trim()\n                    .parse()\n                    .map_err(|_| Error::invalid_argument(\"bad Content-Length\"))?;\n            }\n        }\n        if content_length > 64 * 1024 * 1024 {\n            return Err(Error::invalid_argument(\"request body too large (64 MiB cap)\"));\n        }\n\n        let mut body = buf[header_end + 4..].to_vec();\n        while body.len() < content_length {\n            let mut more = vec![0u8; (content_length - body.len()).min(4096)];\n            let n = stream.read(&mut more)?;\n            if n == 0 {\n                return Err(Error::invalid_argument(\"connection closed mid-body\"));\n            }\n            body.extend_from_slice(&more[..n]);\n        }\n        body.truncate(content_length);\n\n        Ok(Request {\n            method,\n            path,\n            query,\n            body,\n        })\n    }\n}\n\nfn find_double_crlf(buf: &[u8]) -> Option<usize> {\n    buf.windows(4).position(|w| w == b\"\\r\\n\\r\\n\")\n}\n\nfn parse_query(q: &str) -> HashMap<String, String> {\n    let mut map = HashMap::new();\n    for pair in q.split('&') {\n        if pair.is_empty() {\n            continue;\n        }\n        let (k, v) = pair.split_once('=').unwrap_or((pair, \"\"));\n        map.insert(percent_decode(k), percent_decode(v));\n    }\n    map\n}\n\nfn percent_decode(s: &str) -> String {\n    let bytes = s.as_bytes();\n    let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(bytes.len());\n    let mut i = 0;\n    while i < bytes.len() {\n        match bytes[i] {\n            b'+' => {\n                out.push(b' ');\n                i += 1;\n            }\n            b'%' if i + 2 < bytes.len() => {\n                let hi = (bytes[i + 1] as char).to_digit(16);\n                let lo = (bytes[i + 2] as char).to_digit(16);\n                if let (Some(hi), Some(lo)) = (hi, lo) {\n                    out.push((hi * 16 + lo) as u8);\n                    i += 3;\n                } else {\n                    out.push(bytes[i]);\n                    i += 1;\n                }\n            }\n            b => {\n                out.push(b);\n                i += 1;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    String::from_utf8_lossy(&out).into_owned()\n}\n\nstruct Response {\n    status: u16,\n    body: String,\n}\n\nimpl Response {\n    fn json(status: u16, body: String) -> Response {\n        Response { status, body }\n    }\n}\n\nfn status_text(code: u16) -> &'static str {\n    match code {\n        200 => \"OK\",\n        201 => \"Created\",\n        400 => \"Bad Request\",\n        404 => \"Not Found\",\n        405 => \"Method Not Allowed\",\n        409 => \"Conflict\",\n        500 => \"Internal Server Error\",\n        _ => \"OK\",\n    }\n}\n\nfn write_response(stream: &mut TcpStream, resp: &Response) -> Result<()> {\n    let head = format!(\n        \"HTTP/1.1 {} {}\\r\\nContent-Type: application/json\\r\\nContent-Length: {}\\r\\nConnection: close\\r\\n\\r\\n\",\n        resp.status,\n        status_text(resp.status),\n        resp.body.len()\n    );\n    stream.write_all(head.as_bytes())?;\n    stream.write_all(resp.body.as_bytes())?;\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Routing\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nfn route(req: &mut Request, dir: &Path) -> Response {\n    match dispatch(req, dir) {\n        Ok(r) => r,\n        Err(e) => {\n            let status = match &e {\n                Error::InvalidArgument(_) | Error::Corruption(_) => 400,\n                Error::Io(io) if io.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => 404,\n                Error::Io(io) if io.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::AlreadyExists => 409,\n                Error::Io(_) => 500,\n            };\n            Response::json(\n                status,\n                json_object(&[\n                    (\"ok\", Json::Bool(false)),\n                    (\"error_kind\", Json::Str(e.kind())),\n                    (\"error\", Json::Str(&e.to_string())),\n                ]),\n            )\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nfn dispatch(req: &Request, dir: &Path) -> Result<Response> {\n    let segments: Vec<&str> = req\n        .path\n        .split('/')\n        .filter(|s| !s.is_empty())\n        .collect();\n\n    match (req.method.as_str(), segments.as_slice()) {\n        (m, [\"healthz\"]) if m == \"GET\" => Ok(Response::json(\n            200,\n            json_object(&[(\"ok\", Json::Bool(true)), (\"service\", Json::Str(\"psst\"))]),\n        )),\n\n        (m, [\"tables\"]) if m == \"GET\" => list_tables(dir),\n\n        (m, [\"tables\", name]) if m == \"PUT\" || m == \"POST\" => {\n            create_table(req, dir, name)\n        }\n        (m, [\"tables\", name]) if m == \"DELETE\" => delete_table(dir, name),\n\n        (m, [\"tables\", name, \"get\"]) if m == \"GET\" => get_entry(req, dir, name),\n        (m, [\"tables\", name, \"scan\"]) if m == \"GET\" => scan(req, dir, name),\n        (m, [\"tables\", name, \"validate\"]) if m == \"POST\" || m == \"GET\" => {\n            validate_table(dir, name)\n        }\n\n        _ => Ok(Response::json(\n            404,\n            json_object(&[\n                (\"ok\", Json::Bool(false)),\n                (\"error\", Json::Str(\"no such endpoint; see /healthz and README\")),\n            ]),\n        )),\n    }\n}\n\nfn table_path(dir: &Path, name: &str) -> Result<PathBuf> {\n    table::validate_table_name(name)?;\n    Ok(dir.join(name))\n}\n\nfn open_table(dir: &Path, name: &str) -> Result<Table<PosixReader>> {\n    Table::open_path(&table_path(dir, name)?)\n}\n\nfn list_tables(dir: &Path) -> Result<Response> {\n    let mut names: Vec<String> = Vec::new();\n    for entry in std::fs::read_dir(dir)? {\n        let entry = entry?;\n        let n = entry.file_name();\n        let name = n.to_string_lossy();\n        if !name.starts_with('.') {\n            names.push(name.into_owned());\n        }\n    }\n    names.sort();\n    let arr: Vec<Json> = names.iter().map(|n| Json::Str(n)).collect();\n    Ok(Response::json(\n        200,\n        json_object(&[(\"ok\", Json::Bool(true)), (\"tables\", Json::Arr(arr))]),\n    ))\n}\n\nfn create_table(req: &Request, dir: &Path, name: &str) -> Result<Response> {\n    table::validate_table_name(name)?;\n    let parsed = ParseBody::parse(&req.body)?;\n    let mut options = Options::default();\n    if let Some(v) = parsed.field(\"block_size\") {\n        options.block_size = v.as_usize()?;\n    }\n    if let Some(v) = parsed.field(\"restart_interval\") {\n        options.restart_interval = v.as_u64()? as u32;\n    }\n\n    let entries_json = parsed\n        .field(\"entries\")\n        .ok_or_else(|| Error::invalid_argument(\"missing `entries` array\"))?;\n    let pairs = entries_json.as_pairs_hex()?;\n    if pairs.is_empty() {\n        return Err(Error::invalid_argument(\n            \"refusing to build a table with zero entries\",\n        ));\n    }\n\n    let unique = SystemTime::now()\n        .duration_since(UNIX_EPOCH)\n        .map(|d| d.as_nanos() as u64)\n        .unwrap_or(0)\n        ^ std::process::id() as u64;\n    let stats: BuildStats =\n        table::build_table_sorted(dir, name, &pairs, options, unique)?;\n\n    Ok(Response::json(\n        201,\n        json_object(&[\n            (\"ok\", Json::Bool(true)),\n            (\"table\", Json::Str(name)),\n            (\"bytes\", Json::Num(stats.bytes)),\n            (\"entries\", Json::Num(stats.entries)),\n            (\"data_blocks\", Json::Num(stats.data_blocks)),\n        ]),\n    ))\n}\n\nfn delete_table(dir: &Path, name: &str) -> Result<Response> {\n    table::remove_table_file(dir, name)?;\n    Ok(Response::json(\n        200,\n        json_object(&[(\"ok\", Json::Bool(true)), (\"deleted\", Json::Str(name))]),\n    ))\n}\n\nfn get_hex_param<'a>(req: &'a Request, key: &str) -> Result<Option<Vec<u8>>> {\n    match req.query.get(key) {\n        Some(raw) => Ok(Some(coding::from_hex(raw)?)),\n        None => Ok(None),\n    }\n}\n\nfn get_entry(req: &Request, dir: &Path, name: &str) -> Result<Response> {\n    let table = open_table(dir, name)?;\n    let key = get_hex_param(req, \"key\")?\n        .ok_or_else(|| Error::invalid_argument(\"missing `key` hex query parameter\"))?;\n    match table.get(&key)? {\n        Some(value) => Ok(Response::json(\n            200,\n            json_object(&[\n                (\"ok\", Json::Bool(true)),\n                (\"found\", Json::Bool(true)),\n                (\"key\", Json::Str(&coding::to_hex(&key))),\n                (\"value\", Json::Str(&coding::to_hex(&value))),\n            ]),\n        )),\n        None => Ok(Response::json(\n            200,\n            json_object(&[\n                (\"ok\", Json::Bool(true)),\n                (\"found\", Json::Bool(false)),\n                (\"key\", Json::Str(&coding::to_hex(&key))),\n            ]),\n        )),\n    }\n}\n\nfn scan(req: &Request, dir: &Path, name: &str) -> Result<Response> {\n    let table = open_table(dir, name)?;\n\n    let start = match get_hex_param(req, \"start\")? {\n        Some(k) => {\n            if req.query.get(\"start_exclusive\").is_some() {\n                Bound::Excluded(k)\n            } else {\n                Bound::Included(k)\n            }\n        }\n        None => Bound::Unbounded,\n    };\n    let end = match get_hex_param(req, \"end\")? {\n        Some(k) => {\n            if req.query.get(\"end_inclusive\").is_some() {\n                Bound::Included(k)\n            } else {\n                Bound::Excluded(k)\n            }\n        }\n        None => Bound::Unbounded,\n    };\n    let limit = match req.query.get(\"limit\") {\n        Some(s) => Some(\n            s.parse::<u64>()\n                .map_err(|_| Error::invalid_argument(\"bad `limit`\"))?,\n        ),\n        None => None,\n    };\n\n    let mut iter = table.scan(ScanOptions { start, end, limit })?;\n    let mut rows: Vec<Json> = Vec::new();\n    while let Some((k, v)) = }\n}\n\nfn json_object(fields: &[(&str, Json)]) -> String {\n    let owned: Vec<(String, Json)> = fields\n        .iter()\n        .map(|(k, _)| (k.to_string(), Json::Null))\n Dependency-free local HTTP verification endpoint.\n//!\n//! Binary keys/values cross the wire as lowercase hex strings. JSON is emitted\n//! and parsed by the tiny helpers in this module — the only accepted request\n//! content type is a small JSON object, so a full JSON dependency is overkill.\n\nuse std::collections::HashMap;\nuse std::io::{Read, Write};\nuse std::net::{TcpListener, TcpStream};\nuse std::path::{Path, PathBuf};\nuse std::sync::Arc;\nuse std::thread;\nuse std::time::{SystemTime, UNIX_EPOCH};\n\nuse crate::coding;\nuse crate::error::{Error, Result};\nuse crate::table::{\n    self, Bound, BuildStats, Options, ScanOptions, Table, ValidationReport,\n};\nuse crate::io::PosixReader;\n\n/// Server configuration and the directory tables live in.\npub struct HttpServer {\n    dir: PathBuf,\n    listener: TcpListener,\n}\n\nimpl HttpServer {\n    pub fn bind(dir: PathBuf, addr: &str) -> Result<HttpServer> {\n        std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir)?;\n        let listener = TcpListener::bind(addr)?;\n        Ok(HttpServer { dir, listener })\n    }\n\n    pub fn local_addr(&self) -> Result<String> {\n        Ok(self.listener.local_addr()?.to_string())\n    }\n\n    /// Accept connections until the process is killed.\n    pub fn serve(self) -> Result<()> {\n        let dir = Arc::new(self.dir);\n        for stream in self.listener.incoming() {\n            match stream {\n                Ok(stream) => {\n                    let dir = Arc::clone(&dir);\n                    thread::spawn(move || {\n                        if let Err(e) = handle_connection(stream, &dir) {\n                            eprintln!(\"connection error: {e}\");\n                        }\n                    });\n                }\n                Err(e) => eprintln!(\"accept error: {e}\"),\n            }\n        }\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n\nfn handle_connection(mut stream: TcpStream, dir: &Path) -> Result<()> {\n    stream.set_read_timeout(Some(std::time::Duration::from_secs(10)))?;\n    stream.set_nodelay(true)?;\n\n    let mut req = Request::read(&mut stream)?;\n    let response = route(&mut req, dir);\n    write_response(&mut stream, &response)?;\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Request / response types\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nstruct Request {\n    method: String,\n    path: String,\n    query: HashMap<String, String>,\n    body: Vec<u8>,\n}\n\nimpl Request {\n    fn read(stream: &mut TcpStream) -> Result<Request> {\n        let mut buf = Vec::with_capacity(8192);\n        let mut tmp = [0u8; 4096];\n        let header_end = loop {\n            if let Some(pos) = find_double_crlf(&buf) {\n                break pos;\n            }\n            if buf.len() > 64 * 1024 {\n                return Err(Error::invalid_argument(\"headers too large\"));\n            }\n            let n = stream.read(&mut tmp)?;\n            if n == 0 {\n                return Err(Error::invalid_argument(\"connection closed mid-request\"));\n            }\n            buf.extend_from_slice(&tmp[..n]);\n        };\n\n        let head = String::from_utf8_lossy(&buf[..header_end]).to_string();\n        let mut lines = head.split(\"\\r\\n\");\n        let request_line = lines\n            .next()\n            .ok_or_else(|| Error::invalid_argument(\"empty request line\"))?;\n        let mut parts = request_line.split(' ');\n        let method = parts\n            .next()\n            .ok_or_else(|| Error::invalid_argument(\"missing method\"))?\n            .to_string();\n        let target = parts\n            .next()\n            .ok_or_else(|| Error::invalid_argument(\"missing target\"))?;\n        let (path, query) = match target.split_once('?') {\n            Some((p, q)) => (p.to_string(), parse_query(q)),\n            None => (target.to_string(), HashMap::new()),\n        };\n\n        let mut content_length = 0usize;\n        for line in lines {\n            if let Some(rest) = line\n                .strip_prefix(\"Content-Length:\")\n                .or_else(|| line.strip_prefix(\"content-length:\"))\n            {\n                content_length = rest\n                    .trim()\n                    .parse()\n                    .map_err(|_| Error::invalid_argument(\"bad Content-Length\"))?;\n            }\n        }\n        if content_length > 64 * 1024 * 1024 {\n            return Err(Error::invalid_argument(\"request body too large (64 MiB cap)\"));\n        }\n\n        let mut body = buf[header_end + 4..].to_vec();\n        while body.len() < content_length {\n            let mut more = vec![0u8; (content_length - body.len()).min(4096)];\n            let n = stream.read(&mut more)?;\n            if n == 0 {\n                return Err(Error::invalid_argument(\"connection closed mid-body\"));\n            }\n            body.extend_from_slice(&more[..n]);\n        }\n        body.truncate(content_length);\n\n        Ok(Request {\n            method,\n            path,\n            query,\n            body,\n        })\n    }\n}\n\nfn find_double_crlf(buf: &[u8]) -> Option<usize> {\n    buf.windows(4).position(|w| w == b\"\\r\\n\\r\\n\")\n}\n\nfn parse_query(q: &str) -> HashMap<String, String> {\n    let mut map = HashMap::new();\n    for pair in q.split('&') {\n        if pair.is_empty() {\n            continue;\n        }\n        let (k, v) = pair.split_once('=').unwrap_or((pair, \"\"));\n        map.insert(percent_decode(k), percent_decode(v));\n    }\n    map\n}\n\nfn percent_decode(s: &str) -> String {\n    let bytes = s.as_bytes();\n    let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(bytes.len());\n    let mut i = 0;\n    while i < bytes.len() {\n        match bytes[i] {\n            b'+' => {\n                out.push(b' ');\n                i += 1;\n            }\n            b'%' if i + 2 < bytes.len() => {\n                let hi = (bytes[i + 1] as char).to_digit(16);\n                let lo = (bytes[i + 2] as char).to_digit(16);\n                if let (Some(hi), Some(lo)) = (hi, lo) {\n                    out.push((hi * 16 + lo) as u8);\n                    i += 3;\n                } else {\n                    out.push(bytes[i]);\n                    i += 1;\n                }\n            }\n            b => {\n                out.push(b);\n                i += 1;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    String::from_utf8_lossy(&out).into_owned()\n}\n\nstruct Response {\n    status: u16,\n    body: String,\n}\n\nimpl Response {\n    fn json(status: u16, body: String) -> Response {\n        Response { status, body }\n    }\n}\n\nfn status_text(code: u16) -> &'static str {\n    match code {\n        200 => \"OK\",\n        201 => \"Created\",\n        400 => \"Bad Request\",\n        404 => \"Not Found\",\n        405 => \"Method Not Allowed\",\n        409 => \"Conflict\",\n        500 => \"Internal Server Error\",\n        _ => \"OK\",\n    }\n}\n\nfn write_response(stream: &mut TcpStream, resp: &Response) -> Result<()> {\n    let head = format!(\n        \"HTTP/1.1 {} {}\\r\\nContent-Type: application/json\\r\\nContent-Length: {}\\r\\nConnection: close\\r\\n\\r\\n\",\n        resp.status,\n        status_text(resp.status),\n        resp.body.len()\n    );\n    stream.write_all(head.as_bytes())?;\n    stream.write_all(resp.body.as_bytes())?;\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Routing\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nfn route(req: &mut Request, dir: &Path) -> Response {\n    match dispatch(req, dir) {\n        Ok(r) => r,\n        Err(e) => {\n            let status = match &e {\n                Error::InvalidArgument(_) | Error::Corruption(_) => 400,\n                Error::Io(io) if io.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::NotFound => 404,\n                Error::Io(io) if io.kind() == std::io::ErrorKind::AlreadyExists => 409,\n                Error::Io(_) => 500,\n            };\n            Response::json(\n                status,\n                json_object(&[\n                    (\"ok\", Json::Bool(false)),\n                    (\"error_kind\", Json::Str(e.kind())),\n                    (\"error\", Json::Str(&e.to_string())),\n                ]),\n            )\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nfn dispatch(req: &Request, dir: &Path) -> Result<Response> {\n    let segments: Vec<&str> = req\n        .path\n        .split('/')\n        .filter(|s| !s.is_empty())\n        .collect();\n\n    match (req.method.as_str(), segments.as_slice()) {\n        (m, [\"healthz\"]) if m == \"GET\" => Ok(Response::json(\n            200,\n            json_object(&[(\"ok\", Json::Bool(true)), (\"service\", Json::Str(\"psst\"))]),\n        )),\n\n        (m, [\"tables\"]) if m == \"GET\" => list_tables(dir),\n\n        (m, [\"tables\", name]) if m == \"PUT\" || m == \"POST\" => {\n            create_table(req, dir, name)\n        }\n        (m, [\"tables\", name]) if m == \"DELETE\" => delete_table(dir, name),\n\n        (m, [\"tables\", name, \"get\"]) if m == \"GET\" => get_entry(req, dir, name),\n        (m, [\"tables\", name, \"scan\"]) if m == \"GET\" => scan(req, dir, name),\n        (m, [\"tables\", name, \"validate\"]) if m == \"POST\" || m == \"GET\" => {\n            validate_table(dir, name)\n        }\n\n        _ => Ok(Response::json(\n            404,\n            json_object(&[\n                (\"ok\", Json::Bool(false)),\n                (\"error\", Json::Str(\"no such endpoint; see /healthz and README\")),\n            ]),\n        )),\n    }\n}\n\nfn table_path(dir: &Path, name: &str) -> Result<PathBuf> {\n    table::validate_table_name(name)?;\n    Ok(dir.join(name))\n}\n\nfn open_table(dir: &Path, name: &str) -> Result<Table<PosixReader>> {\n    Table::open_path(&table_path(dir, name)?)\n}\n\nfn list_tables(dir: &Path) -> Result<Response> {\n    let mut names: Vec<String> = Vec::new();\n    for entry in std::fs::read_dir(dir)? {\n        let entry = entry?;\n        let n = entry.file_name();\n        let name = n.to_string_lossy();\n        if !name.starts_with('.') {\n            names.push(name.into_owned());\n        }\n    }\n    names.sort();\n    let arr: Vec<Json> = names.iter().map(|n| Json::Str(n)).collect();\n    Ok(Response::json(\n        200,\n        json_object(&[(\"ok\", Json::Bool(true)), (\"tables\", Usage:\n//!\n//! ```text\n//! psst serve --dir ./tabledata --addr 127.0.0.1:8088\n//! ```\n\nuse std::path::PathBuf;\nuse std::process::ExitCode;\n\nuse psst::server::HttpServer;\n\nfn main() -> ExitCode {\n    let args: Vec<String> = std::env::args().collect();\n    match run(&args) {\n        Ok(()) => ExitCode::SUCCESS,\n        Err(msg) => {\n            eprintln!(\"psst: {msg}\");\n            ExitCode::FAILURE\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nfn run(args: &[String]) -> Result<(), String> {\n    let mut dir = PathBuf::from(\"./tabledata\");\n    let mut addr = String::from(\"127.0.0.1:8088\");\n\n    let mut iter = args.iter().skip(1);\n    let cmd = iter.next().ok_or_else(|| usage())?;\n    if cmd != \"serve\" {\n        return Err(usage());\n    }\n    while let Some(arg) = iter.next() {\n        match arg.as_str() {\n            \"--dir\" | \"-d\" => {\n                dir = PathBuf::from(iter.next().ok_or(\"--dir needs a value\")?);\n            }\n            \"--addr\" | \"-a\" => {\n                addr = iter.next().ok_or(\"--addr needs a value\")?.clone();\n            }\n            \"--help\" | \"-h\" => {\n                println!(\"{USAGE}\");\n                return Ok(());\n            }\n            other => return Err(format!(\"unknown argument: {other}\")),\n        }\n    }\n\n    let server = HttpServer::bind(dir, &addr).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;\n    println!(\n        \"psst serving {} on http://{}\",\n        server\n            .local_addr()\n            .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?,\n        addr\n    );\n    server.serve().map_err(|e| e.to_string())\n}\n\nconst USAGE: &str = \"\\\npsst — prefix-compressed sorted table, local HTTP verification server\n\nUSAGE:\n    psst serve [--dir DIR] [--addr HOST:PORT]\n\nOPTIONS:\n    -d, --dir <DIR>      directory for table files (default ./tabledata)\n    -a, --addr <ADDR>   listen address (default 127.0.0.1:8088)\n    -h, --help           show this help\n\nENDPOINTS (keys/values are hex strings):\n    GET    /healthz\n    GET    /tables\n    PUT    /tables/{name}            body: {\\\"entries\\\":[[key,value],...], ...options}\n    DELETE /tables/{name}\n    GET    /tables/{name}/get?key=<hex>\n    GET    /tables/{name}/scan?start=<hex>&end=<hex>&end_inclusive&limit=N\n    POST   /tables/{name}/validate\n\";\n\nfn usage() -> String {\n    \"missing or unknown command\\n\".to_string() + USAGE\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_990c67959cbe0c102c2780e4","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1241,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":96056,"output_tokens":913,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_sasojhrgfaa4n0ndwjrrqqx4":{"content":"//! Shared helpers for integration tests: in-memory table construction and a\n//! small deterministic PRNG for reproducible \"random\" suites.\n\n#![allow(dead_code)]\n\nuse psst::io::{MemReader, MemStore, MemWriter};\nuse psst::table::{Options, Table, TableBuilder};\nuse psst::Result;\nuse std::collections::BTreeMap;\n\n/// xorshift64* — tiny, fast, deterministic; no rand dependency needed.\npub struct Rng {\n    state: u64,\n}\n\nimpl Rng {\n    pub fn new(seed: u64) -> Rng {\n        Rng {\n            state: if seed == 0 { 0x9e37_79b9_7f4a_7c15 } else { seed },\n        }\n    }\n\n    pub fn next_u64(&mut self) -> u64 {\n        let mut x = self.state;\n        x ^= x >> 12;\n        x ^= x << 25;\n        x ^= x >> 27;\n        self.state = x;\n        x.wrapping_mul(0x2545_f491_4f6c_dd1d)\n    }\n\n    pub fn below(&mut self, bound: u64) -> u64 {\n        self.next_u64() % bound\n    }\n\n    /// Fill `out` with `n` pseudo-random bytes.\n    pub fn bytes(&mut self, out: &mut Vec<u8>, n: usize) {\n        out.clear();\n        while out.len() < n {\n            let chunk = self.next_u64().to_le_bytes();\n            let take = (n - out.len()).min(8);\n            out.extend_from_slice(&chunk[..take]);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n/// Build a table in memory from already-sorted unique pairs.\npub fn build_mem(\n    sorted: &[(Vec<u8>, Vec<u8>)],\n    options: Options,\n) -> Result<(MemStore, u64)> {\n    let store = MemStore::new();\n    let writer = MemWriter::new(store.clone());\n    let mut builder = TableBuilder::new(writer, options)?;\n    for (k, v) in sorted {\n        builder.add(k, v)?;\n    }\n    let stats = builder.finish()?;\n    assert_eq!(stats.bytes as usize, store.len());\n    Ok((store, stats.bytes))\n}\n\npub fn open_mem(store: &MemStore) -> Result<Table<MemReader>> {\n    let size = store.len() as u64;\n    Table::open(MemReader::new(store.clone()), size)\n}\n\n/// Deterministic random sorted map of `count` entries.\npub fn random_map(rng: &mut Rng, count: usize) -> BTreeMap<Vec<u8>, Vec<u8>> {\n    let mut map = BTreeMap::new();\n    while map.len() < count {\n        let klen = 1 + (rng.below(24) as usize);\n        let mut k = Vec::new();\n        rng.bytes(&mut k, klen);\n        let vlen = rng.below(32) as usize;\n        let mut v = Vec::new();\n        rng.bytes(&mut v, vlen);\n        map.insert(k, v);\n    }\n    map\n}\n\n/// BTreeMap contents as sorted pairs.\npub fn map_pairs(map: &BTreeMap<Vec<u8>, Vec<u8>>) -> Vec<(Vec<u8>, Vec<u8>)> {\n    map.iter().map(|(k, v)| (k.clone(), v.clone())).collect()\n}\n\n/// Options that force small blocks so the index is genuinely sparse.\npub fn tiny_options() -> Options {\n    Options {\n        block_size: 120,\n        restart_interval: 4,\n    }\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_47156249d3aac36dccc22186","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1134,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":105272,"output_tokens":1061,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_n1hm2nyyriapzjiu4jnrvio8":{"content":"//! {"parentUuid":"087bb0e7-18e0-453a-bde4-77f4f408aea8","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_1elapagbvg4gexme3cqhf7im","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp8/b/tests/random_diff.rs","content":"//! Differential testing against `BTreeMap` over random keys:\n//! point gets, full scans, bounded scans and validation agree, across many\n//! seeds and block/interval sizes.\n\nmod common;\n\nuse common::*;\nuse psst::table::{collect_scan, Bound, Options, ScanOptions};\nuse std::collections::BTreeMap;\n\n#[test]\nfn random_get_and_scan_match_btreemap_across_seeds() {\n    for seed in 1u64..=40 {\n        let mut rng = Rng::new(seed.wrapping_mul(0x1234_567));\n        let count = 1 + (rng.below(400) as usize);\n        let map = random_map(&mut rng, count);\n        let pairs = map_pairs(&map);\n\n        let options = Options {\n            block_size: 40 + (rng.below(300) as usize),\n            restart_interval: 1 + (rng.below(8) as u32),\n        };\n        let (store, size) = build_mem(&pairs, options).expect(\"build\");\n        let table = open_mem(&store).expect(\"open\");\n\n        // Validation must pass for every generated file.\n        let report = table.validate().expect(\"validation\");\n        assert_eq!(report.file_size, size);\n        assert_eq!(report.total_entries, pairs.len());\n        assert!(report.data_blocks.len() >= 1);\n        if pairs.len() > 6 {\n            assert!(\n                report.data_blocks.len() > 1,\n                \"seed {seed}: expected multiple small blocks\"\n            );\n        }\n\n        // 1. Every stored key returns exactly its value.\n        for (k, v) in &map {\n            assert_eq!(table.get(k).unwrap().as_ref(), Some(v));\n        }\n\n        // 2. Random probes: present keys match; absent keys return None.\n        for _ in 0..300 {\n            let mut probe = Vec::new();\n            let len = 1 + (rng.below(24) as usize);\n            rng.bytes(&mut probe, len);\n            match table.get(&probe).unwrap() {\n                Some(v) => assert_eq!(map.get(&probe).unwrap(), &v, \"seed {seed}\"),\n                None => assert!(!map.contains_key(&probe), \"seed {seed}\"),\n            }\n        }\n\n        // 3. Full scan equals the map in order.\n        let all = collect_scan(&table, ScanOptions::default()).unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(all, pairs, \"seed {seed}: full scan mismatch\");\n\n        // 4. Bounded scans against BTreeMap ranges.\n        for _ in 0..30 {\n            let mut lo = Vec::new();\n            let mut hi = Vec::new();\n            rng.bytes(&mut lo, 1 + rng.below(24) as usize);\n            rng.bytes(&mut hi, 1 + rng.below(24) as usize);\n            if lo > hi {\n                std::mem::swap(&mut lo, &mut hi);\n            }\n            let lo_excl = rng.next_u64() & 1 == 0;\n            let hi_incl = rng.next_u64() & 1 == 0;\n\n            let start = if lo_excl {\n                Bound::Excluded(lo.clone())\n            } else {\n                Bound::Included(lo.clone())\n            };\n            let end = if hi_incl {\n                Bound::Included(hi.clone())\n            } else {\n                Bound::Excluded(hi.clone())\n            };\n\n            let got = collect_scan(\n                &table,\n                ScanOptions {\n                    start,\n                    end,\n                    limit: None,\n                },\n            )\n            .unwrap();\n\n            let expected: Vec<(Vec<u8>, Vec<u8>)> = map\n                .range(lo.clone()..=hi.clone())\n                .filter(|(k, _)| {\n                    let ok_lo = if lo_excl { **k > lo } else { **k >= lo };\n                    let ok_hi = if hi_incl { **k <= hi } else { **k < hi };\n                    ok_lo && ok_hi\n                })\n                .map(|(k, v)| (k.clone(), v.clone()))\n                .collect();\n            assert_eq!(got, expected, \"seed {seed}: bounded scan mismatch\");\n        }\n\n        // 5. Half-open / unbounded scans and limits.\n        let first_key = pairs.first().unwrap().0.clone();\n        let last_key = pairs.last().unwrap().0.clone();\n        let from_third = collect_scan(\n            &table,\n            ScanOptions {\n                start: Bound::Included(first_key.clone()),\n                end: Bound::Excluded(last_key.clone()),\n                limit: None,\n            },\n        )\n        .unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(from_third.len(), pairs.len() - 1);\n\n        let limited = collect_scan(\n            &table,\n            ScanOptions {\n Acceptance edge cases: empty keys, long common prefixes and cross-block\n//! range scans, called out explicitly in the project requirements.\n\nmod common;\n\nuse common::*;\nuse psst::table::{collect_scan, Bound, Options, ScanOptions};\n\n#[test]\nfn empty_key_point_get_and_ordering() {\n    let pairs = vec![\n        (vec![], b\"empty\".to_vec()),\n        (vec![0x00], b\"zero\".to_vec()),\n        (vec![0x00, 0x00], b\"zeros\".to_vec()),\n        (b\"a\".to_vec(), b\"a\".to_vec()),\n    ];\n    let (store, _) = build_mem(&pairs, tiny_options()).unwrap();\n    let table = open_mem(&store).unwrap();\n    table.validate().unwrap();\n\n    assert_eq!(table.get(&[]).unwrap(), Some(b\"empty\".to_vec()));\n    assert_eq!(table.get(&[0x00]).unwrap(), Some(b\"zero\".to_vec()));\n    assert_eq!(table.get(&[0x00, 0x00]).unwrap(), Some(b\"zeros\".to_vec()));\n    assert_eq!(table.get(b\"missing\").unwrap(), None);\n\n    let all = collect_scan(&table, ScanOptions::default()).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(all, pairs);\n\n    // Scan starting exactly at the empty key returns everything.\n    let from_empty = collect_scan(\n        &table,\n        ScanOptions {\n            start: Bound::Included(vec![]),\n            end: Bound::Unbounded,\n            limit: None,\n        },\n    )\n    .unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(from_empty, pairs);\n\n    // Start boundary strictly greater than empty skips it.\n    let after_empty = collect_scan(\n        &table,\n        ScanOptions {\n            start: Bound::Excluded(vec![]),\n            end: Bound::Unbounded,\n            limit: None,\n        },\n    )\n    .unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(after_empty, pairs[1..].to_vec());\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn long_common_prefix_still_gets_and_scans() {\n    let prefix = b\"prefix-compression-shared-prefix-\".repeat(20); // ~680 bytes\n    let mut pairs = Vec::new();\n    for i in 0..60u32 {\n        let mut k = prefix.clone();\n        k.extend_from_slice(format!(\"{i:06}\").as_bytes());\n        let mut v = vec![i as u8; 1 + (i as usize % 5)];\n        v.extend_from_slice(b\"value\");\n        pairs.push((k, v));\n    }\n    // Also a key that is a strict prefix of others.\n    pairs.insert(0, (b\"p\".to_vec(), b\"single-p\".to_vec()));\n    pairs.sort_by(|a, b| a.0.cmp(&b.0));\n    pairs.dedup_by(|a, b| a.0 == b.0);\n\n    let (store, raw_size) = build_mem(\n        &pairs,\n        Options {\n            block_size: 256,\n            restart_interval: 4,\n        },\n    )\n    .unwrap();\n    let table = open_mem(&store).unwrap();\n    let report = table.validate().unwrap();\n    assert!(report.data_blocks.len() >= 3);\n\n    // Prefix compression must actually shrink the file: naive storage would be\n    // at least sum(key.len()) bytes plus overhead.\n    let naive_keys: usize = pairs.iter().map(|(k, _)| k.len()).sum();\n    assert!(\n        (raw_size as usize) < naive_keys,\n        \"file {raw_size} should be smaller than naive key bytes {naive_keys}\"\n    );\n\n    for (k, v) in &pairs {\n        assert_eq!(table.get(k).unwrap().as_ref(), Some(v));\n    }\n    let all = collect_scan(&table, ScanOptions::default()).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(all, pairs);\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn cross_block_scan_with_narrow_bounds() {\n    // Keys distributed over many blocks; ranges deliberately start and end\n    // inside different blocks and exercise every alignment (block boundary,\n    // restart-point boundary, mid-interval entry).\n    let pairs: Vec<(Vec<u8>, Vec<u8>)> = (0..500u32)\n        .map(|i| {\n            (\n                format!(\"k/{i:05}\").into_bytes(),\n                format!(\"v{i}\").into_bytes(),\n            )\n        })\n        .collect();\n    let (store, _) = build_mem(\n        &pairs,\n        Options {\n            block_size: 110,\n            restart_interval: 4,\n        },\n    )\n    .unwrap();\n    let table = open_mem(&store).unwrap();\n    let report = table.validate().unwrap();\n    assert!(report.data_blocks.len() > 20);\n\n    // Range that spans most of the file.\n    let mid = collect_scan(\n        &table,\n        ScanOptions {\n            start: Bound::Included(b\"k/00100\".to_vec()),\n            end: Bound::Excluded(b\"k/00400\".to_vec()),\n            limit: None,\n        },\n    )\n    .unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(mid.len(), 300);\n    assert_eq!(mid.first().unwrap().0, b\"k/00100\");\n    assert_eq!(mid.last().unwrap().0, b\"k/00399\");\n\n    // Inclusive end on a key that sits at a block/ restart boundary.\n    let incl = collect_scan(\n        &table,\n        ScanOptions {\n            start: Bound::Included(b\"k/00000\".to_vec()),\n            end: Bound::Included(b\"k/00004\".to_vec()),\n            limit: None,\n        },\n    )\n    .unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(incl.len(), 5);\n\n    // Start strictly between existing keys.\n    let gap = collect_scan(\n        &table,\n        ScanOptions {\n            start: Bound::Included(b\"k/00123X\".to_vec()),\n            end: Bound::Excluded(b\"k/00126\".to_vec()),\n            limit: None,\n        },\n    )\n    .unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(\n        gap.iter().map(|(k, _)| k.clone()).collect::<Vec<_>>(),\n        vec![b\"k/00124\".to_vec(), b\"k/00125\".to_vec()]\n    );\n\n    // Empty range: start past the end.\n    let none = collect_scan(\n        &table,\n        ScanOptions {\n            start: Bound::Included(b\"z\".to_vec()),\n            end: Bound::Unbounded,\n            limit: None,\n        },\n    )\n    .unwrap();\n    assert!(none.is_empty());\n\n    // Empty range contained within one block gap.\n    let none2 = collect_scan(\n        &table,\n        ScanOptions {\n            start: Bound::Included(b\"k/00200X\".to_vec()),\n            end: Bound::Excluded(b\"k/00200Y\".to_vec()),\n            limit: None,\n        },\n    )\n    .unwrap();\n    assert!(none2.is_empty());\n\n    // Limit applied mid cross-block scan.\n    let lim = collect_scan(\n        &table,\n        ScanOptions {\n            start: Bound::Included(b\"k/00000\".to_vec()),\n            end: Bound::Unbounded,\n            limit: Some(37),\n        },\n    )\n    .unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(lim.len(), 37);\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn empty_table_is_usable_and_valid() {\n    let (store, _) = build_mem(&[], Options::default()).unwrap();\n    let table = open_mem(&store).unwrap();\n    let report = table.validate().unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(report.total_entries, 0);\n    assert!(report.data_blocks.is_empty());\n    assert_eq!(table.get(b\"anything\").unwrap(), None);\n    let all = collect_scan(&table, ScanOptions::default()).unwrap();\n Strict format validation: every corruption class must be reported as\n//! `Error::Corruption`, never silently accepted.\n//!\n//! The headline case is a **corrupted restart offset**: a payload mutation alone\n//! would be caught by the block CRC first, so for that case the test recomputes\n//! the (masked) checksum after tampering, forcing the reader past the CRC layer\n//! into structural validation where the restart array is checked.\n\nmod common;\n\nuse common::*;\nuse psst::block::Block;\nuse psst::coding::{self, mask_crc, crc32c};\nuse psst::error::Error;\nuse psst::format::{\n    write_block as encode_block, BlockHandle, Footer, BLOCK_TRAILER_LEN,\n    BLOCK_TYPE_DATA, FOOTER_LEN,\n};\nuse psst::io::MemStore;\nuse psst::table::{Options, ScanOptions};\n\nfn sample_bytes() -> Vec<u8> {\n    let pairs: Vec<(Vec<u8>, Vec<u8>)> = (0..200u32)\n        .map(|i| (format!(\"k/{i:04}\").into_bytes(), format!(\"v{i}\").into_bytes()))\n        .collect()\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn injected_append_failure_aborts_build_and_leaves_no_success() {\n    let pairs = fails.\n            fail_append_at: Some(0),\n            ..WriteFaults::default()\n        },\n    );\n    let mut builder = TableBuilder::new(writer, Options::default()).unwrap();\n    let mut failed = false;\n    for (k, v) in &pairs {\n        if builder.add(k, v).is_err() {\n            failed = true;\n            break;\n        }\n    }\n    if !failed {\n        let err = builder.finish().unwrap_err();\n        assert!(matches!(err, Error::Io(_)), \"got {err}\");\n    }\n    // Whatever partial bytes exist must not parse as a table.\n    let open = injected_late_append_failure_during_finish() {\n    let pairs = sample_pairs();\n    let store = MemStore::new();\n    // Count appends: with tiny blocks there are several data appends; make the\n    // index-block append (one of the last) fail instead.\n    let writer = CountingWriter::new(MemWriter::new(store.clone()));\n    let mut builder = TableBuilder::new(\n        writer,\n        Options expected appends is awkward through the consumed builder;\n    // instead rebuild with a fault at a high call index guaranteed to land on\n    // one of the finish-time appends for this data set.\n    drop(builder);\n\n    let store2 = MemStore::new();\n    let writer = FaultyWriter::new(\n        MemWriter::new(store2.clone()),\n        WriteFaults {\n            fail_append_at: Some(40),\n            ..WriteFaults::default()\n        },\n    );\n    let mut builder = TableBuilder::new(\n        writer,\n        Options {\n            block_size: 64,\n            restart_interval: 4,\n        },\n    )\n    .unwrap();\n    for (k, v) in &pairs {\n        builder.add(k, v).unwrap();\n    }\n    let err = builder.finish().unwrap_err();\n    assert!(matches!(err, Error::Io(_)), \"finish MemWriter::new(store),\n        WriteFaults {\n            fail_sync_at: Some(0),\n            ..WriteFaults::default()\n        },\n    );\n    let mut builder = TableBuilder::new(writer, error: {err}\");\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn short_writes_are_retried_and_file_is_byte_identical() {\n    let pairs = sample_pairs();\n    let (good_store, size) = build_mem(&pairs, tiny_options()).unwrap();\n\n    let faulty_store = MemStore::new();\n    let writer = FaultyWriter::new(\n        MemWriter::new(faulty_store.clone()),\n        WriteFaults {\n            // Every = build_mem(&pairs, tiny_options()).unwrap();\n    let reader = FaultyReader::new(\n        MemReader::new(store),\n        ReadFaults {\n            max_bytes_per_read: Some(7),\n            ..ReadFaults::default()\n        },\n    );\n    let table = Table::open(reader, size).unwrap();\n    table.validate().unwrap();\n    for (k, v) in pairs.iter().step_by(7) {\n },\n    );\n    let err = Table::open(reader, size).unwrap_err();\n    assert!(matches!(err, Error::Io(_)), \"got {err}\");\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn injected_read_error_during_get_surfaces_as_io() {\n    let    CountingWriter { inner }\n    }\n}\nimpl<W: psst::io::WritableFile> psst::io::WritableFile for CountingWriter<W> {\n    fn append(&mut self, data: &[u8]) -> psst::Result<usize> {\n self, _data: &[u8]) -> psst::Result<usize> {\n        Ok(0) // append_all must treat zero progress as an error\n    }\n    fn sync(&mut self) -> psst::Result<()> {\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n\nstruct OverReader;\nimpl psst::io::RandomAccessFile for OverReader {\n    fn read_at(&self, buf: &mut [u8], _offset: u64) -> psst::Result<usize> {\n        Ok(buf.len() + 1) // impossible count\n Injectable I/O layer: injected write/read faults surface as `Error::Io`,\n//! the storage layer retries partial writes and fragmented reads, and the\n//! durability boundary (`sync`) is exercised explicitly.\n\nmod common;\n\nuse common::*;\nuse psst::error::Error;\nuse psst::io::{\n    append_all, read_fill, FaultyReader, FaultyWriter, MemReader, MemStore,\n    MemWriter, ReadFaults, WriteFaults,\n};\nuse psst::table::{collect_scan, Options, ScanOptions, Table, TableBuilder};\n\nfn sample_pairs() -> Vec<(Vec<u8>, Vec<u8>)> {\n    (0..300u32)\n        .map(|i| (format!(\"k/{i:04}\").into_bytes(), format!(\"v{i}\").into_bytes()))\n        .collect()\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn injected_append_failure_aborts_build_and_leaves_no_success() {\n    let pairs = sample_pairs();\n    let store = MemStore::new();\n    let writer = FaultyWriter::new(\n        MemWriter::new(store.clone()),\n        WriteFaults {\n            // The very first data block append fails.\n            fail_append_at: Some(0),\n            ..WriteFaults::default()\n        },\n    );\n    let mut builder = TableBuilder::new(writer, Options::default()).unwrap();\n    let mut failed = false;\n    for (k, v) in &pairs {\n        if builder.add(k, v).is_err() {\n            failed = true;\n            break;\n        }\n    }\n    if !failed {\n        let err = builder.finish().unwrap_err();\n        assert!(matches!(err, Error::Io(_)), \"got {err}\");\n    }\n    // Whatever partial bytes exist must not parse as a table.\n    let open = Table::open(MemReader::new(store.clone()), store.len() as u64);\n    assert!(matches!(open, Err(Error::Io(_)) | Err(Error::Corruption(_))));\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn injected_late_append_failure_during_finish() {\n    let pairs = sample_pairs();\n    let store = MemStore::new();\n    // Count appends: with tiny blocks there are several data appends; make the\n    // index-block append (one of the last) fail instead.\n    let writer = CountingWriter::new(MemWriter::new(store.clone()));\n    let mut builder = TableBuilder::new(\n        writer,\n        Options {\n            block_size: 64,\n            restart_interval: 4,\n        },\n    )\n    .unwrap();\n    for (k, v) in &pairs {\n        builder.add(k, v).unwrap();\n    }\n    // Drain to count expected appends is awkward through the consumed builder;\n    // instead rebuild with a fault at a high call index guaranteed to land on\n    // one of the finish-time appends for this data set.\n    drop(builder);\n\n    let store2 = MemStore::new();\n    let writer = FaultyWriter::new(\n        MemWriter::new(store2.clone()),\n        WriteFaults {\n            fail_append_at: Some(40),\n            ..WriteFaults::default()\n        },\n    );\n    let mut builder = TableBuilder::new(\n        writer,\n        Options {\n            block_size: 64,\n            restart_interval: 4,\n        },\n    )\n    .unwrap();\n    for (k, v) in &pairs {\n        builder.add(k, v).unwrap();\n    }\n    let err = builder.finish().unwrap_err();\n    assert!(matches!(err, Error::Io(_)), \"finish error: {err}\");\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn injected_sync_failure_propagates_from_finish() {\n    let pairs = sample_pairs();\n    let store = MemStore::new();\n    let writer = FaultyWriter::new(\n        MemWriter::new(store),\n        WriteFaults {\n            fail_sync_at: Some(0),\n            ..WriteFaults::default()\n        },\n    );\n    let mut builder = TableBuilder::new(writer, Options::default()).unwrap();\n    for (k, v) in &pairs {\n        builder.add(k, v).unwrap();\n    }\n    let err = builder.finish().unwrap_err();\n    assert!(matches!(err, Error::Io(_)), \"sync error: {err}\");\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn short_writes_are_retried_and_file_is_byte_identical() {\n    let pairs = sample_pairs();\n    let (good_store, size) = build_mem(&pairs, tiny_options()).unwrap();\n\n    let faulty_store = MemStore::new();\n    let writer = FaultyWriter::new(\n        MemWriter::new(faulty_store.clone()),\n        WriteFaults {\n            // Every append only accepts 1..=7 bytes, repeatedly.\n            short_write_at: Some((u64::MAX, 0)), // never triggers by exact index\n            ..WriteFaults::default()\n        },\n    );\n    drop(writer);\n\n    // Instead exercise repeated short writes across *all* appends with a\n    // dedicated writer wrapper below.\n    let faulty_store2 = MemStore::new();\n    let writer = AlwaysShort {\n        inner: MemWriter::new(faulty_store2.clone()),\n        max: 3,\n    };\n    let mut builder = TableBuilder::new(writer, tiny_options()).unwrap();\n    for (k, v) in &pairs {\n        builder.add(k, v).unwrap();\n    }\n    let stats = builder.finish().unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(stats.bytes, size);\n    assert_eq!(faulty_store2.snapshot(), good_store.snapshot());\n\n    // And the resulting table reads correctly.\n    let table = Table::open(MemReader::new(faulty_store2.clone()), size).unwrap();\n    table.validate().unwrap();\n    let all = collect_scan(&table, ScanOptions::default()).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(all.len(), pairs.len());\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn fragmented_reads_still_produce_correct_results() {\n    let pairs = sample_pairs();\n    let (store, size) = build_mem(&pairs, tiny_options()).unwrap();\n    let reader = FaultyReader::new(\n        MemReader::new(store),\n        ReadFaults {\n            max_bytes_per_read: Some(7),\n            ..ReadFaults::default()\n        },\n    );\n    let table = Table::open(reader, size).unwrap();\n    table.validate().unwrap();\n    for (k, v) in pairs.iter().step_by(7) {\n        assert_eq!(table.get(k).unwrap().as_ref(), Some(v));\n    }\n    let all = collect_scan(&table, ScanOptions::default()).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(all.len(), pairs.len());\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn injected_read_error_during_footer_open_surfaces_as_io() {\n    let pairs = sample_pairs();\n    let (store, size) = build_mem(&pairs, tiny_options()).unwrap();\n    let reader = FaultyReader::new(\n        MemReader::new(store),\n        ReadFaults {\n            // The first read fetches the footer; fail it.\n            fail_read_at_call: Some(0),\n            ..ReadFaults::default()\n        },\n    );\n    let err = Table::open(reader, size).unwrap_err();\n    assert!(matches!(err, Error::Io(_)), \"got {err}\");\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn injected_read_error_during_get_surfaces_as_io() {\n    let pairs = sample_pairs();\n    let (store, size) = build_mem(&pairs, tiny_options()).unwrap();\n    let reader = FaultyReader::new(\n        MemReader::new(store),\n        ReadFaults {\n            // open() reads footer (1 call) + index block; fail call 2.\n            fail_read_at_call: Some(2),\n            ..ReadFaults::default()\n        },\n    );\n    // Depending on fragmentation counts the failure may land in open or get;\n    // either way it must be an IO error, never a wrong answer.\n    match Table::open(reader, size) {\n        Ok(table) => {\n            let err = table.get(b\"k/00150\").unwrap_err();\n            assert!(matches!(err, Error::Io(_)), \"got {err}\");\n        }\n        Err(Error::Io(_)) => {}\n        Err(other) => panic!(\"expected IO error, got {other}\"),\n    }\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn io_helpers_reject_impossible_counts() {\n    let store = MemStore::new();\n    let mut w = BadWriter;\n    assert!(append_all(&mut w, b\"abc\").is_err());\n\n    let mut buf = [0u8; 4];\n    let r = OverReader;\n    assert!(read_fill(&r, &mut buf, 0).is_err());\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Test-only writer wrappers\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nstruct AlwaysShort<W> {\n    inner: W,\n    max: usize,\n}\nimpl<W: psst::io::WritableFile> psst::io::WritableFile for AlwaysShort<W> {\n    fn append(&mut self, data: &[u8]) -> psst::Result<usize> {\n        let n = self.max.min(data.len()).max(1);\n        self.inner.append(&data[..n])\n    }\n    fn sync(&mut self) -> psst::Result<()> {\n        self.inner.sync()\n    }\n}\n\nstruct CountingWriter<W> {\n    inner: W,\n}\nimpl<W> CountingWriter<W> {\n    fn new(inner: W) -> Self {\n        CountingWriter { inner }\n    }\n}\nimpl<W: psst::io::WritableFile> psst::io::WritableFile for CountingWriter<W> {\n    fn append(&mut self, data: &[u8]) -> psst::Result<usize> {\n        self.inner.append(data)\n    }\n    fn sync(&mut self) -> psst::Result<()> {\n        self.inner.sync()\n    }\n}\n\nstruct BadWriter;\nimpl psst::io::WritableFile for BadWriter {\n    fn append(&mut self, _data: &[u8]) -> psst::Result<usize> {\n        Ok(0) // append_all must treat zero progress as an error\n    }\n    fn sync(&mut self) -> psst::Result<()> {\n        Ok(())\n    }\n}\n\nstruct OverReader;\nimpl psst::io::RandomAccessFile for OverReader {\n    fn read_at(&self, buf: &mut [u8], _offset: u64) -> psst::Result<usize> {\n        Ok(buf.len() + 1) // impossible count\n    }\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"aaf60f2d-abff-421e-af55-cf4a9f8d893d","session_id":"778f00cf-4c07-4d49-9d5a-e2a66c2ee10d","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp8/b","sessionId":"778f00cf-4c07-4d49-9d5a-e2a66c2ee10d","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp8-b","slug":"cuddly-puzzling-goblet"}
